claim: Rebase or cherry-pick post-merge orphan PRs onto current main before closing or merging: first-commit conflicts with main usually mean the work already landed via a different PR path.

decisions.notes: orama #133 cherry-pick onto d1d607e conflicted on security files already in #127; 10 remaining file diffs were regressions vs main
